title: mcp: the draft door serves no read of a metadata type's contract, so a door-only client cannot see what a type accepts before it saves
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1PJ4isQ3eD7Fk1fnF

Filing gate: ④ a child of the MCP build line #35152, split out of #34778. It is the follow-up that #34778's landing left owed: seat record 7025763862 on PR #35665, item 5: 「草稿门不提供 schema 读取，另立席位卡」. Source: fleet. Reader: the `domain:server` lane (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts`, `packages/mcp`). Dedupe: `schema draft door mcp` (open) found #34778, #34659 and #34689, and none of them covers it. `mcp schema contract metadata type` found none.

Grade: p2 · area:ai · Feature · evidence read on `main` `cceb5c626d3c`. It inherits the grade of #34778 (p2), the card it splits from, as #35264 did from #34780. The ruled procedure of #34778 (#34691 S3 = A: inspect, read the contract, save, read the verdict) has no door for its second step.

## 维护者速读
- 要做的：在 MCP 草稿门上加一个只读入口，让外部 AI 客户端能读到某个元数据类型(流程、仪表盘等)允许写哪些字段、哪些必填。
- 为什么：现在只用 MCP 搭建的客户端看不到这份规则。环境里还没有同类条目时，它只能猜字段，靠保存被拒一次次试，搭建慢，也容易出错。Studio 和 REST 早就能读到同一份规则。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Measured (objectstack `main` `cceb5c626d3c`)

- The draft door serves exactly five tools: `list_metadata_items`, `get_metadata_item`, `list_drafts`, `save_metadata_draft` and `delete_metadata_draft` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.ts:194-304`). Each takes a `type` string (`:176-180`), and none returns that type's schema, required keys or create seed. `get_metadata_item` returns one existing item. `save_metadata_draft` takes `item` as a bare `{ type: 'object' }` (`:272`).
- The open server's other reads do not cover it either. `describe_object` returns a data object's fields (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:3685-3698`). The `metadata_types` resource lists type names only, `{ types, totalCount }` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts:2422-2440`).
- The platform already builds the contract. `getMetaTypes` derives a JSON Schema per type from `getMetadataTypeSchema` and adds a `createSeed` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts:612`, `:647-657`). REST serves this as `GET /meta/types` (`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts:274`), and Studio's forms read it. MCP does not expose it.
- The shipped skill works around the gap. `skills/objectstack-mcp-build/SKILL.md:50-55` says: where the client cannot read files, "read a published item of the same type, and let the save check you". A type with no published item in the environment therefore has no contract source on the door. The client learns the shape only from the Zod refusals of `save_metadata_draft`.

## Done when

- A client on the draft door, holding `metadata:write` and the caller's `manage_metadata`, can read one type's contract in a single call: its JSON Schema (from the same `getMetadataTypeSchema` path as `/meta/types`) and its create seed, where one exists. A type with no schema is answered as such and never with an empty object. This can be a sixth read tool or a field on an existing read, whichever the PR measures as smaller in `tools/list`. It must not undo #34689's slimming, and its byte cost goes in the PR.
- Test (on `examples/app-crm`): the read for `flow` returns a schema whose required keys match `getMetadataTypeSchema('flow')`. A token without `metadata:write`, and an API key, do not see it.
- `skills/objectstack-mcp-build/SKILL.md` section 3 names the new read in place of the "read a published item" fallback. That is a skills-lane follow-up and part of this card's acceptance.

## Out of scope

- Any publish path, and any change to what a save accepts. Hosted (cloud) door registries.

## Relations

- Parent: #35152. Split from: #34778 (closed, completed). Bears on the door-mode eval rounds parked on #35154 (comment 7031811704) and #35264.
